title: Jarrow probe dump, schema 1
description: What the Jarrow probe mod writes to jarrow-dump.json once a headless server has started. The probe (one per loader) writes it; crates/harness validates, canonicalises, diffs and scores it. The prose contract, including what the schema cannot express (sorting, codecs, where the file goes), is in docs/harness.md, section 'The probe dump'.

schema.description: Version of this format. Bumped on any incompatible change; the harness refuses versions it does not know.

loader.description: The loader the server ran on.

loader_version.description: The loader version as the loader reports it, for example 0.20.1 (Fabric Loader) or 21.1.265 (NeoForge).

game_version.description: The Minecraft version the server ran, for example 1.21.1.

mods.description: Every mod the loader loaded (including the loader itself, minecraft and java where the loader lists them), sorted by id.

registries.description: Every static (built-in) and dynamic (data-pack) registry: registry id to its entry ids in iteration (raw id) order.

tags.description: Registry id to tag id (no #) to the resolved members of that tag, sorted. A member without a key is written <direct holder>.

recipes.description: Recipe id to the recipe encoded with the game's own codec.

loot_tables.description: Loot table id to the loot table encoded with the game's own codec.

advancements.description: Advancement id to the advancement encoded with the game's own codec.

worldgen.description: A worldgen sample of the overworld: the world seed, the chunks generated, and a histogram of the block states in them.

seed.description: The overworld seed (a Java long). The harness fixes it in server.properties. null when the probe could not sample worldgen; errors then says why.

chunks.description: Chunk coordinates [x, z] that were generated to full status and counted, in the order the probe visited them.

block_histogram.description: Block state (namespace:path, then [property=value,...] when the block has properties) to the number of positions holding it across the sampled chunks.

log.description: The server log, captured by the probe from startup until the dump was written. One string per log event.

errors.description: Events at ERROR or FATAL level.
Problems the probe itself hit while dumping (for example an entry its codec could not encode). An empty list means the dump is complete.

resource_id.description: A namespaced id as Minecraft writes it: namespace:path.

tag_member.description: A tag member's id, or <direct holder> for a member that has no key.

block_state.description: A block state: a block id, then its properties in brackets when it has any.
